I bought NØRD for the crepey skin on my arms. But the first change my husband noticed was on my legs.

He asked what I had been doing because they looked smoother.

I hadn’t changed my workouts or started another diet. I had simply added NØRD’s Peptide Body Oil to my routine, massaging it into my arms and thighs for five minutes after showering.

I bought it for my arms. What I noticed on my legs is why I ordered another bottle.
